Die Modern Drive Technology GmbH (MDT) ist ein Full-Service-IoT-Cloud-Integrator mit Fokus auf OEMs und Maschinenproduzenten . Mit unserer offenen Plattform ermöglichen wir Herstellern, ihren Maschinen und Produkten eine eigene, vollständig gebrandete digitale Servicewelt zu geben – ohne selbst eine Cloud-Infrastruktur aufbauen zu müssen.
Ob Fernwartung, Predictive Maintenance oder datenbasierte After-Sales-Services: Wir liefern die technologische Grundlage, damit OEMs ihren Kunden smarte Mehrwerte anbieten und neue Geschäftsmodelle erschließen können.
Bereits über 100 Kunden mit mehr als 13.000 vernetzten Einheiten setzen auf unsere Lösung – und wir wachsen weiter.
Aufgaben
Du bist die zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen unseren Kunden und unserem Entwicklungsteam. Du verstehst, was Kunden wirklich brauchen, formulierst es technisch präzise und stellst sicher, dass Projekte strukturiert, termingerecht und im Sinne des Kunden umgesetzt werden.
Dabei bringst du eigene Einschätzungen zu Anforderungen und Prioritäten ein – die finale Roadmap-Entscheidung triffst du gemeinsam mit der Entwicklungsleitung und der Geschäftsführung. Du hältst beide Welten zusammen: die des Kunden und die des Teams.
Deine Aufgaben
Anforderungsaufnahme & Spezifikation – du führst Gespräche mit Kunden, erkennst den eigentlichen Bedarf und übersetzt ihn in klare User Stories und Tickets für das Dev-Team
Kunden-Onboarding & Betreuung – du begleitest neue Kunden von der ersten Integration bis zum produktiven Betrieb und bist langfristiger Ansprechpartner
Produktdemos & Kundenpräsentationen – du präsentierst unsere Plattform überzeugend, technisch fundiert und auf den jeweiligen Kunden zugeschnitten
Koordination & Kommunikation – du hältst Kunden über Projektstatus auf dem Laufenden und sorgst dafür, dass das Dev-Team stets die richtigen Prioritäten kennt
Roadmap-Input – du bündelst Kundenfeedback und Marktanforderungen und bringst sie strukturiert in die Abstimmung mit Entwicklungsleitung und Geschäftsführung ein
Qualifikation

Technisches Grundverständnis – du weißt, wie APIs, Cloud-Architekturen und Softwareentwicklung funktionieren, auch wenn du selbst nicht codest
Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit Entwicklungsteams, z.B. in agilen Projekten (Scrum, Kanban)
Ausgeprägtes Kommunikationsgeschick – du kannst technische Sachverhalte für Kunden verständlich machen und Kundenwünsche präzise ins Team übersetzen
Strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise und Freude daran, den Überblick zu behalten
Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, gute Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil

Erfahrung im IoT-, SaaS- oder Industrieumfeld
Kenntnisse in gängigen Projektmanagement-Tools (z.B. Jira, Linear, Notion)
Erfahrung mit API-Dokumentation oder technischen Spezifikationen
Erfahrung im Kundenprojektgeschäft mit erklärungsbedürftigen Produkten
Präsenz: Ein Tag pro Woche vor Ort in unserem Büro in Neumarkt i.d.Opf. erwünscht
Offen für alle Erfahrungsstufen – ob Berufseinsteiger mit technischem Hintergrund oder erfahrene Projektmanagerin: Wir freuen uns auf dich.

Flexible Arbeitszeiten und anteilige Homeoffice-Möglichkeit
High-End-Ultrabook und Smartphone der neuesten Generation
Zugang zu relevanten Fachmessen (je nach Interesse)
Modernes Büro mit neuester Ausstattung sowie Unlimited-Zugang zu Kaffee, Wasser, Eis und Fachliteratur
Kostenlose Parkplätze direkt am Standort

Lead the coordination and synchronization of technical projects across the organization to ensure alignment with mission priorities.
Identify and allocate resources, including personnel, funding and technology to address operational challenges effectively.
Provide guidance on IT acquisition procurement standards and policies.
Integrate multiple technical and operational war fighting aspects of IT services with senior decision makers, commanders, and contract administrative executives.
Mentor and develop staff, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Provide leadership and direction to a multidisciplinary team of technical experts, ensuring the delivery of high-quality solutions.
Provide leadership and technical direction to a staff of government (military and civilians) and contractor employees.
Who May Apply: Only applicants who meet one of the employment authority categories below are eligible to apply for this job. You will be asked to identify which category or categories you meet, and to provide documents which prove you meet the category or categories you selected.

In order to qualify, you must meet the experience requirements described below. Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community; student; social).

You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience. Your resume must clearly describe your relevant experience; if qualifying based on education, your transcripts will be required as part of your application. Additional information about transcripts is in this document.

Specialized experience is progressively responsible intelligence-related security work directly related to the position being filled.

Creditable experience may include previous military experience, experience gained in the private sector or in another government agency as long as it was at a level at least equivalent to the next lower band in the series.

Basic Requirement for IT PROGRAM MANAGER (POLICY AND PLANNING): Specialized and Other Experience: One year of specialized experience which includes Developing IT policies and procedures governing the planning and delivery of information technology services; Providing guidance and leadership in the planning and integration of information technology requirements; Building partnerships with interagency government organizations; Demonstrating leadership experience overseeing the responsibilities and performance of a diverse team.

This definition of specialized experience is typical of work performed at the next lower grade/level position in the federal service (GS/GG-13).

The specialized experience must include, or be supplemented by, information technology related experience (paid or unpaid experience and/or completion of specific, intensive training, as appropriate) which demonstrates each of the four competencies, as defined: (1) Attention to Detail - Is thorough when performing work and conscientious about attending to detail.

Examples of IT-related experience demonstrating this competency include: leading others by setting the standards for the quality of work, even in the most difficult and/or high pressure circumstances; reviewing and editing work completed by others to ensure that the quality of work meets acceptable work standards.

(2) Customer Service - Works with clients and customers (that is, any individuals who use or receive the services or products that your work unit produces, including the general public, individuals who work in the agency, other agencies, or organizations outside the Government) to assess their needs, provide information or assistance, resolve their problems, or satisfy their expectations; knows about available products and services; is committed to providing quality products and services.

Examples of IT-related experience demonstrating this competency include: using expertise and experience to address complex problems, questions, or complaints; anticipating customer needs and modify the team's work activities, processes, and practices to meet these needs; collaborating across team and outside of own team to organize planning sessions that elicit ideas for improving customer service and support.

(3) Oral Communication - Expresses information (for example, ideas or facts) to individuals or groups effectively, taking into account the audience and nature of the information (for example, technical, sensitive, controversial); makes clear and convincing oral presentations; listens to others, attends to nonverbal cues, and responds appropriately.

Examples of IT-related experience demonstrating this competency include: clearly explaining and defending complex ideas, appropriately adapting to each audience's level of knowledge; actively listening and clarifying points when presenting highly complex and controversial findings; using well-constructed, fact-based arguments to persuade stakeholders/officials to take action on suggestions for improvement.

(4) Problem Solving - Identifies problems; determines accuracy and relevance of information; uses sound judgment to generate and evaluate alternatives, and to make recommendations.

Examples of IT-related experience demonstrating this competency include: providing precedent setting solutions to unique problems not previously encountered; helping team make decisions which are complicated by the number and nature of existing policy, guidelines, and organizational goals; identifying the root causes of problems; developing systemic solutions to address them and prevent them from reoccurring.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT.

Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles.

Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring an Enterprise Project Manager
Canonical’s mission is to streamline and accelerate the adoption of open source across the entire global enterprise technology market. Our customers embrace the Canonical approach to open source for complex projects on bare metal, on the cloud, and at the edge. Canonical Enterprise Project Managers are responsible for ensuring project success through owning, driving, communicating and respectfully engaging all stakeholders, valuing integrity and accountability.
Within a portfolio of projects with complex and changing software technologies, customer and partner satisfaction is only possible because of exceptional Project Managers who know how to respect and engage all stakeholders.
Location: This is a Globally remote role.

Ensuring programs and projects are delivered within the schedule, scope, cost, budget and resources expectations
Identifying key technical and project risks and issues and actively put mitigating actions in place
Maintaining strong customer focus and working with all key stakeholders to achieve successful outcomes
Conducting regular status meetings and business reviews with customers and providing direction when needed
Managing the delivery schedule of critical third party deliverables for the project
Advocating to customers the appropriate technologies from Canonical's portfolio
Driving project success while managing risks

s.h: What we are looking for in you
s.t:
Experience in Enterprise IT Programs, Process Improvement, and Software Engineering Project Management
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
Experience leading cross-cultural, remote and global project teams and customers.
Strong negotiation and influencing skills
Strong communication skills
Deep understanding of Linux, Open Source, and Cloud Technologies
Bachelor's Degree in a STEM discipline
Project Management Certification, preferably PMP or equivalent certification
Agile Project Management certification, preferably Scrum Master or equivalent certification
Ability and willingness to travel domestically and internationally

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year

Recognition rewards
Annual holiday leave
Maternity and paternity leave
Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company.

We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Our proven safety record, technical depth, and longstanding client relationships have made us a partner of choice for Fortune 500 companies, leading general contractors, and EPC contractors.

The SSP Project Manager plays an essential role in growing talent in our business through collaboration and sharing best practices with the Shop and Space Planning team (Shop Design, VM and Construction teams).

In this role, you will have a keen understanding of the bigger picture, ensuring that all projects align with the organization's overarching goals and objectives. You will be solutions-oriented, continuously seeking creative opportunities to overcome challenges.

In addition, you will possess a strong understanding of the financial processes involved in front-end planning, allowing you to effectively navigate these aspects and enhance project execution. You know how to be curious about opportunities and how to be real with feedback and support.

As the SSP Project Manager, you embody the qualities of a detective. You may not know every answer, but take the initiative to actively seek them out. As a solution-focused individual, you will help inspire and galvanize the team.

In addition to supporting the team to achieve the timely delivery of projects, you will be the gatekeeper of quality, by facilitating value-driven meetings, to ensure the team is proud of the projects we deliver.

Your understanding of the business-critical functions and priorities within the Shop & Space Planning team will be crucial within this role. Our ideal candidate can manage difficult conversations, nurture relationships, and knows when to raise something to the appropriate principal, without relying on the need to cross every T.

In this role, it is essential that you possess cross-functional capabilities and a broad, transferable skillset. As with all walks of Lush, you can adapt and evolve to the needs of the business, and help cheerlead our mission and vision.

Our Lush staff live with purpose, finding their personal value connection with the values of the business, bringing their work and life paths into one holistic journey. #mylushlife Reporting to the Shop and Space Planning Managers, the SSP Project Manager undertakes the following RESPONSIBILITIES : In collaboration with the SSP Project Manager team, Oversee and project manage SSP team (Design, VM and Construction) workflow and resources for all projects from start to finish ensuring effective deadlines and capacity management for seamless collaboration.

Successfully maintain the workflow process tools for the SSP team, enhancing structure, planning and transparency for all projects. Including the training of all tools for SSP team members Implement Sprint and squad team projects for SSP ensuring both the effectiveness of this and the founding principles.

Collaborate with other teams to integrate workflows, handle specific requests, and prioritize multiple SSP tasks. Creation & management of spreadsheets, project costing templates, folders and team documents in collaboration with the Global SSP PM team Document projects, maintain a collaborative calendar, and promptly resolve any issues.

Along with the leadership team prioritize relationship strengthening with Retail and key departments for improved working practices. Proactively participate and collaborate in strategy planning meetings with the leadership team to ensure successful planning, resourcing and execution of projects.

Undertake regular check-ins with team members as it pertains to workload and capacity, projects are allocated effectively and deadlines are being maintained. Partner with SSP leaders to identify development and growth opportunities and find solutions while implementing strategy direction.

Continuously assess and improve SSP team processes and tools, driving efficiency and effectiveness. Complete SSP team Admin as needed Shared management and leading of various team meetings.

You bring the following QUALIFICATIONS: Required: 5+ years’ of experience in Planning / Operations and Project Management, preferably in a retail industry, an equivalent combination of both relevant education and experience Proven understanding of project management principles Demonstrated ability to effectively manage and lead project teams Strong business and finance acumen with a talent for analyzing situations and making informed decisions and recommendations Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities Ability to communicate effectively both verbally and in writing Ability to travel both domestically and internationally on occasion Proven wizard skills in spreadsheets, formulas and costing templates.

Preferred: Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, such as Project Management, Design, Construction Management, or a related discipline Experience using design programs such as AutoCAD, Sketchup, or BlueBeam Experience in retail or similar related industries is considered an asset Thriving with a diverse company culture, celebrating the uniqueness of our staff and committed to inclusion.

Buscamos un/a Jefe de Proyectossemi-senior para liderar proyectos mensuales y continuos en Lisit. En este rol nos enfocamos en asegurar una ejecución ordenada, medible y alineada a los objetivos, con gobernanza, control y comunicación efectiva con todas las partes involucradas.

s.h: Responsabilidades clave (sobre el día a día)
s.t:
Planificar y ordenar el trabajo del proyecto: objetivos, alcance, cronograma, recursos, presupuesto, hitos y entregables.
Coordinar equipos internos, externos y proveedores, asignando tareas, seguimiento del desempeño y resolución de conflictos entre áreas.
Conducir el control de avance, alcance y calidad, gestionando cambios y reportando el estado del proyecto a la gerencia.
Gestionar presupuesto y riesgos (tecnológicos y operacionales), con planes de mitigación y escalamiento cuando corresponda.
Ejercer gobierno y documentación: actas/minutas, actualización documental y gestión de lecciones aprendidas, asegurando cumplimiento metodológico.
Gestionar stakeholders y expectativas del negocio, coordinando reuniones de seguimiento y obteniendo aprobaciones formales.
Impulsar la gestión del cambio: capacitaciones, apoyo a la adopción de nuevas tecnologías, gestión de resistencia y acompañamiento de la transición a operación.

s.h: Lo que valoramos para que la persona se desempeñe con éxito
s.t:

ReSource Pro is seeking a Data Governance and Stewardship Lead establishes and maintains the frameworks, standards, and practices that support the integrity, security, compliance, and appropriate use of ReSource Pro ’s data. The role translates data governance principles into practical policies, controls, stewardship practices, and data quality standards that can be consistently applied across a complex, data-intensive environment.
The role works cross-functionally with Data Strategy, Technology, Security, Legal, Compliance, and business stakeholders to define and maintain governance standards for how data is collected, classified, accessed, used, retained, and retired. The Data Governance and Stewardship Lead also supports data quality, lineage, documentation, and stewardship practices that enable the effective use of data for analytics, reporting, automation, and AI.
The role applies strategic and hands-on expertise to establish and maintain data governance practices, translate complex governance requirements into practical policies and guidance, and support consistent adoption and accountability across the organization.
All remote positions are based in the United States, and candidates must reside within the U.S. to be eligible for consideration.
In this role, you will...
Build and Maintain the Data Governance and Stewardship Framework
Develop, document, and maintain data governance policies, standards, procedures, and controls that support the appropriate collection, classification, storage, access, use, retention, and retirement of data.
Define and maintain data ownership, accountability, stewardship, and quality responsibilities across business and functional areas.
Establish practical and scalable governance practices that can be consistently applied across a complex, data-intensive organization.
Maintain clear documentation of governance requirements, decision rights, standards, and operating practices.
Partner with data owners, stewards, and cross-functional stakeholders to implement governance standards and resolve data-related issues.
Develop guidance and education that help stakeholders understand and fulfill their data governance and stewardship responsibilities.
Drive Data Quality, Lineage, and Data Lifecycle Management
Define and maintain data quality standards, rules, and processes for critical data assets.
Establish monitoring and control mechanisms to identify data errors, gaps, inconsistencies, and other quality issues.
Partner with data owners and stewards to investigate root causes, prioritize remediation, and improve data quality over time.
Maintain data lineage and documentation to improve traceability from source systems through downstream use.
Support the development and maintenance of data catalogs, business glossaries, metadata, and other documentation that improve understanding and accessibility of governed data.
Help ensure data assets can be traced, understood, and appropriately governed throughout their lifecycle.
Monitor adherence to established data governance and quality standards and communicate findings, risks, and remediation needs to relevant stakeholders.
Support Data Privacy, Security, Client Commitments, and Responsible Data Use
Partner with Security, Legal, Compliance, and other stakeholders to support data privacy, security, risk management, and regulatory requirements.
Translate contractual and client-specific data requirements into clear governance standards, controls, and operating practices.
Support governance of how client and company data may be accessed, used, stored, shared, retained, and retired.
Maintain appropriate documentation and evidence to demonstrate adherence to applicable data requirements and commitments.
Identify and escalate governance risks, gaps, and potential areas of non-compliance.
Partner with analytics, technology, and AI teams to ensure data used for automation, analytics, and AI applications meets applicable governance, privacy, security, quality, and documentation requirements.
Support governance practices that promote responsible and explainable use of data in AI-enabled solutions.
Monitor Adoption and Continuously Improve Governance Practices
Develop metrics, reporting, and other mechanisms to monitor governance adoption, data quality, and areas of risk or improvement.
Track adherence to data governance standards and support remediation where practices fall short.
Serve as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert on data governance and stewardship questions.
Promote data literacy and effective stewardship practices through clear documentation, training, and engagement.
Facilitate collaboration among data owners, stewards, and technical teams to resolve governance and data quality issues.
Continuously refine governance practices as regulations, client requirements, business needs, and technology evolve.
Teamwork & Collaboration (Standard)
Foster a respectful and collaborative environment by upholding professionalism and engaging in constructive and respectful conversations.
Support a positive workplace culture by promoting open, solution-oriented communication, encouraging teamwork, and maintaining a focus on shared goals and productivity.
What You Need to be Successful...
Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree in Data Management, Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.
5–8 years of experience in data governance, data stewardship, data management, data quality, or a related discipline.

s.h: Experience working in the insurance industry preferred.
s.t:
Experience supporting data governance for analytics, automation, machine learning, or AI use cases.
Familiarity with data governance frameworks, data management best practices, or relevant industry standards.
Experience implementing or improving data governance programs in a growing or changing organization.
Behavioral/technical skills; Competencies
Hands-on experience developing, implementing, or maintaining data governance frameworks, policies, standards, and controls.
Experience establishing practices related to data quality, classification, access, retention, privacy, or lifecycle management.
Working knowledge of data privacy, security, regulatory, and compliance requirements in a regulated or data-intensive environment.
Experience with data catalogs, metadata management, data lineage, data quality tools, or related data management technologies.
Strong data fluency, including the ability to understand data structures, relationships, sources, and downstream use; experience with SQL is preferred.
Ability to translate complex governance, privacy, security, and data management requirements into clear policies and practical guidance.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify root causes and drive sustainable remediation.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Strong attention to detail and a disciplined approach to documentation, process, and follow-through.

The specialty area of the degree must be consistent with the assignment for which the applicant is to be employed.

OR, have a doctoral degree in any area of psychology and, in addition, successfully completed a re-specialization program meeting both of the following conditions: a) the re-specialization program must be completed in an APA or a CPA accredited doctoral program; and b) the specialty in which you were retrained is consistent with the assignment you are am applying for; OR, have a doctoral degree awarded between 1951 and 1978 from a regionally-accredited institution, with a dissertation primarily psychological in nature.

Internship Requirement - You must have successfully completed a professional psychology internship training program that was accredited by APA or CPA at the time the program was completed and that is consistent with the assignment for which the applicant is to be employed; OR, New VHA psychology internship programs that are in the process of applying for APA accreditation are acceptable in fulfillment of the internship requirement, provided that such programs were sanctioned by the VHA Central Office Program Director for Psychology and the VHA Office of Academic Affiliations at the time that the individual was an intern; OR, VHA facilities that offered full-time, one-year pre-doctoral internships prior to PL 96-151 (pre-1979) are considered to be acceptable in fulfillment of the internship requirement; OR, Applicants who completed an internship that was not accredited by APA or CPA at the time the program was completed may be considered eligible for hire only if they are currently board certified by the American Board of Professional Psychology in a specialty area that is consistent with the assignment for which the applicant is to be employed.

(NOTE: Once board certified, the employee is required to maintain board certification).

NOTE: Applicants who have a doctoral degree awarded between 1951 and 1978 from a regionally-accredited institution with a dissertation primarily psychological in nature may fulfill this internship requirement by having the equivalent of a one-year supervised internship experience in a site specifically acceptable to the candidate's doctoral program.

If the internship experience is not noted on the applicant's official transcript, the applicant must provide a statement from the doctoral program verifying that the equivalent of a one-year supervised internship experience was completed in a site acceptable to the doctoral program.

Licensure: Candidates must hold a full, current, and unrestricted license to practice psychology at the doctoral level in a State, Territory or Commonwealth of the United States, or the District of Columbia.

Exception: Non-licensed applicants who otherwise meet the eligibility requirements may be given a temporary appointment as a "graduate psychologist" at the GS-11 or GS-12 grade under the authority of 38 U.S.C. 7405 (c)(2)(B) for a period not to exceed two years from the date of employment on the condition that such a psychologist provide care only under the supervision of a psychologist who is licensed.

Failure to obtain licensure during that period is justification for termination of the temporary appointment.

Psychologist program managers have broad program management responsibilities for a specific program or programs that are designed to deliver specialized, complex, highly professional services that are important program components of the facility and that significantly impact the health care provided to Veterans.

Programs include but are not limited to addiction, posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD), mental health intensive case management (MHICM), mental health compensation and pension examination (C&P) programs, Psychosocial Rehabilitation and Recovery Centers, inpatient mental health, residential rehabilitation, domiciliary, palliative care, neuropsychology, and internship and postdoctoral fellowship training programs; management of an off campus site; psychology program oversight and coordination throughout the facility and its affiliated clinics as a psychology executive, typically at lower complexity facilities.

Responsibilities include operation and management of key clinical, training, research, or administrative programs to include full responsibility for managing the day to day activities of those programs. Responsibility may include supervision of staff but is not required.

Psychologist Program Managers are responsible for strategic planning to ensure the provision of high quality services to meet the needs of the Veterans being served and planning, and developing and implementing short- and long-term goals and objectives consistent with the program's strategic plan.

They have oversight of administrative and programmatic resources and deploy those resources in support of the program needs.

They develop and implement programs, policies, and procedures to meet program goals, VHA policy and external accreditation requirements, and monitor outcomes using data-driven quality assurance processes, and implement strategies for improvement based on data analysis. Preferred Experience: Experience with VA mental health clinical services.

Als Mitglied des Verwaltungsrates sind Sie mitverantwortlich für
* die angemessene und wirksame Oberaufsicht über die Geschäftsführung der Bank
* die finanzielle Lage und Entwicklung der Bank
* die Erarbeitung und Festlegung der Strategie der Raiffeisenbank St.Gallen sowie für die Überprüfung ihrer Umsetzung
* die Einhaltung der Gesetze und Vorschriften sowie für das Risikomanagement
Innerhalb des Verwaltungsrates bringen Sie Ihren Bankenhintergrund ein. Dazu gehören
* die Beurteilung, Analyse und Besprechung von Kreditgeschäften, die in der Kompetenz des Verwaltungsrats liegen

* die periodische Überprüfung der Entwicklung und der Struktur des Kreditportfolios anhand bereitgestellter Reportings

* Sie identifizieren sich mit den genossenschaftlichen Werten sowie den Führungsgrundsätzen von Raiffeisen und vertreten diese überzeugend.
* Sie verfügen über fundierte Erfahrung im Finanzdienstleistungssektor und bringen ein vertieftes Verständnis für Finanzprodukte, Geschäftsmodelle und Organisationsstrukturen mit. Zudem verfügen Sie über solide betriebs- und volkswirtschaftliche Kenntnisse sowie ausgewiesene Erfahrung im Bankgeschäft, insbesondere im Privatkunden- und/oder Firmenkundengeschäft.

* Sie kennen die regulatorischen und normativen Anforderungen des Schweizer Finanzmarktes und sind in der Lage, deren Auswirkungen auf die strategische und operative Ausrichtung einer Raiffeisenbank fundiert zu beurteilen.

* Sie können das Mandat während mindestens zwei aufeinanderfolgenden Amtsperioden ausüben. Die statuarische Altersgrenze für Mitglieder des Verwaltungsrats liegt bei 70 Jahren.
Bitte beachten Sie, dass der Lebenslauf (CV) für die Bewerbung als Verwaltungsratsmitglied, gemäss aktuell gültiger Bankenverordnung zwingend zu unterzeichnen ist.

At Zurich, our ambition is to put customers at the heart of everything we do and become the insurer of choice by building meaningful relationships that earn customer loyalty over time.
Over the past several years, we have made significant progress in building customer thinking into our strategy, products, services and ways of working. However, there is still more to do to ensure customer perspectives consistently shape decisions across the organisation and become embedded in our everyday mindset and culture. We believe better customer understanding leads to better business decisions.
The Group Customer Office plays a central role in this transformation, partnering with markets and functions around the world to ensure the voice of the customer is heard, understood and acted upon. Through customer, market and brand insights, we help the business better understand changing customer needs, identify opportunities for improvement and make decisions that strengthen customer loyalty, drive growth and create long-term value.
To support this effort, we are looking for a passionate, curious and commercially minded insights professional to join our Customer, Market & Brand Insights team. This role is paramount in translating our data and research into actionable insights that influence business decisions and drive meaningful change.
Working closely with markets, regional stakeholders and senior leaders, you will help evolve and deliver our global brand and experience insights tracking tools to deliver value to the business, ensuring customer understanding influences business decisions and actions.
As we continue to embrace AI and new analytical capabilities, we are also transforming how insight is generated and activated, allowing us to spend less time producing reports and more time influencing decisions and delivering impact.
Reporting to the Head of Global Brand Tracking & NPS, this role will focus on understanding how our brand health created through our products, services and experiences shapes customer perceptions and behaviours, and ensuring those insights are translated into actions that improve customer outcomes and business performance.

s.h: As Senior Insight Manager you will
s.t:
* Champion the voice of the customer, helping embed customer thinking into decision-making across Zurich.
* Generate compelling customer and brand insights that influence to drive business impact
* Oversee Zurich's global retail Brand and Relationship NPS programmes and lead our Commercial Broker study, ensuring high-quality delivery, governance and business value.
* Evolve our insight programmes and measurement approaches to ensure they remain relevant to changing customer and business needs.
* Transform complex data into clear, actionable recommendations and executive-level narratives that drive action.
* Partner with the insights team, markets, agencies and business stakeholders to identify opportunities, solve business challenges and accelerate customer-centred change.
* Connect customer, brand and business data to strengthen understanding of performance drivers and commercial impact.
* Facilitate discussions and workshops that turn insight into tangible business outcomes.
* Work closely with the Tracking Insight Manager and TNPS Expert to maximise the impact, adoption and activation of insights across the organisation.
* Bring external best practice, innovation and emerging AI capabilities into Zurich's insight ecosystem to continuously enhance how we generate and apply insight.
Work location is Zurich with travel potentially required up to 10%

s.h: As Senior Insight Manager, you will bring
s.t:
* A passion for understanding customers and translating customer, market and brand data into meaningful business opportunities and actions.
* Strong storytelling and communication skills, with the ability to distil complex information into clear, compelling narratives that influence decision-making.
* Proven experience activating insights within organisations, driving awareness, engagement and action across diverse stakeholder groups.
* Expertise in leading continuous and ad hoc qualitative and quantitative research programmes, either within an in-house insights function or consultancy environment.
* Strong commercial acumen and the ability to connect customer insights with business performance, growth and loyalty outcomes.
* Experience managing complex global programmes and building effective relationships across markets, functions and cultures.
* Demonstrated ability to influence and engage senior stakeholders, facilitating discussions and workshops that drive alignment and action.
* Curiosity and practical experience applying AI and emerging technologies to enhance insight generation, synthesis and activation.
* Strong analytical skills with experience working with large datasets and statistical tools (e.g. Excel, SPSS), turning data into actionable recommendations.
* Experience bringing together multiple data sources to identify performance drivers and generate deeper business understanding.
* A degree (e.g. in business studies, marketing, research, psychology, behavioural science, customer or change management or a related field), alongside significant experience in customer, market or brand insights.
* Knowledge of the insurance sector is beneficial but not essential; curiosity, commercial thinking and a customer-first mindset are critical.
* Fluent English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

HubSpot (CMS, custom modules, APIs), Jira, Confluence, Forecast, Claude and Claude Code, GitHub and GitHub Actions, MCP-based agent tooling, Miro, Figma for design handover.

As we deepen our collaboration with our parent company, dwpbank, we are looking for a highly strategic and execution-focused person to lead one of our most important cross-company initiatives.
In this role, you will act as the central coordination point for a joint offering with dwpbank. You will bring clarity to complexity, align stakeholders across both organizations, and drive the overall program across commercial, product, and governance workstreams. Your job is to ensure that the right topics move forward, dependencies are surfaced early, and teams stay focused on what matters most.

Own the overall coordination of a critical cross-company strategic program between lemon.markets and dwpbank.
Help shape how lemon.markets’ and dwpbank’s offerings come together into a compelling joint proposition for shared customers.
Collaborate closely with product, engineering, operations, legal, and commercial stakeholders to ensure seamless execution across the full value chain.
Act as the connective layer across teams and senior stakeholders, ensuring that priorities, decisions, risks, and dependencies are transparent and actively managed.
Work closely with senior leaders at lemon.markets and dwpbank to keep the program on track and escalate where needed.
Identify strategic risks and opportunities early, connect the dots across domains, and proactively steer the program accordingly.
Translate complex discussions and developments into clear recommendations, concrete next steps, and actionable decisions.
Keep momentum high across all involved stakeholders by driving follow-through, enabling effective communication across teams, building bridges between organizations and functions, and ensuring lemoneers and leadership have the right information and context at the right time.
Partner with internal commercial teams and dwpbank counterparts to support business development efforts for the joint offering.

s.h: You’ll be successful in this role if you
s.t:
Bring strong experience in program management, strategic project leadership, or change delivery in a complex financial-services environment.
Have experience in securities services, custody, brokerage, wealth management, asset management, or adjacent financial infrastructure environments.
Understand how to navigate regulated environments and cross-functional dependencies across multiple senior stakeholders.
Are able to absorb complex context quickly, structure ambiguity, and turn it into practical action.
Are not just a status-tracker: you bring judgment, anticipate what matters, and actively steer topics before they become problems.
Combine strategic thinking with a hands-on mindset, strong execution discipline, and a clear drive to make progress.
Are a patient, thoughtful communicator who can build trust, create alignment, and move topics forward across organizational boundaries and seniority levels.
Know how to facilitate communication across diverse stakeholder groups, ensure the right context is shared with the right people, and help teams stay aligned even in complex or sensitive situations.
Have strong commercial instincts and understand how product, execution, and business development interact in strategic initiatives.
Are fluent in German and English.
